Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
What if Muaziz equips with the Ankara Citadel, and Clan
Impersonates into a Lasombra, and then learns Obtenebration,
and his/her controller puts the Path of Night in play, and
afterwards Muaziz plays a Summon the Abyss (3 blood cost)?.

Which card effect applies first, the Ankara Citadel or the Path
of Night?

If the Ankara Citadel halves the cost of any minion card and
the Path of Night reduces by one the cost of any card requiring
Obtenebration, would the cost of the Summon the Abyss be zero?

Greetings,
Damnans

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The halving occurs first, then the reduction. Summon the Abyss
would cost her zero (3/2 = 1, 1-1 = 0)
